Title: Guest checkout with card
Steps:
Open the shop without logging in
Add any in-stock product to the cart
Choose "Continue as guest" at checkout
Pay with the test card
Expected Result: Order confirmation page shows an order number and the cart is empty

Title: Apply coupon SAVE10
Preconditions: Logged in with an item in the cart
Steps: 1. Go to checkout 2. Enter SAVE10 and tap Apply 3. Pay with the test card
Expected Result: Total drops by 10 percent, Pay stays enabled and the order is placed

Title: Checkout on slow 3G
Preconditions: Turn on a slow network setting
Steps:
- Add an item to the cart
- Pay with the test card
Expected Result: Loading states are visible, nothing is charged twice

Title: Keyboard-only checkout
Steps: Using only Tab, Enter and Space, add an item and complete checkout
Expected Result: Every control is reachable and focus is always visible
